info.name: WisePlayer API – Fully Automated
info.description:
Zero-setup Postman collection. Run requests in order — every token, deviceId, playlistId, and secret is captured automatically from responses and injected into subsequent requests via collection variables.

⚙️ Only change {{baseUrl}} if your server runs on a different port.

🔑 Auth flow:
- Device: Register → Validate (auto-captures token + fingerprint + deviceSecret + deviceId)
- Reseller: Login (auto-captures resellerToken)
- Admin: Login (auto-captures adminToken)

All other headers/params are wired from those captured variables.

item.name: 📂 Series
item.description:
4-step flow: Categories → Series list → Series Info (seasons/episodes) → Episode playback URL.
URL format: /series/{user}/{pass}/{episodeId}.{ext}
